roots.reset_epoch: actual parent rq[1] synchronous serial release; same interface

policy: 833.333ps signoff /770ps route unchanged; no runtime flow or price relaxation

P_convention.bench_sk: one based serial counter incremented at edge; drive fc at edge+10ps
P_convention.P: zero based serial edge where last element is actually sampled at leaf pin; equals bench drive sk numerically because drive uses prior edge then next sample
P_convention.PIPE0: leaf postNBA at P+1; x34 bank write at P+2
P_convention.PIPE1: leaf postNBA at P+2; x34 bank write at P+3
P_convention.stream: zero based output edge 4*floor(q/3)+2+q%3, q=x34 serial bank write zero based; bench tk is one based, +1
P_convention.trace: LEAF_POST/STREAM_POST printed +1ps after actual edge; sample/bank exact edge
